text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament adopts law on trade courts aiming at promoting foreign investments.
- France expected to lend Morocco 520 million francs to build nuclear research centre and purchase nine railway engines.
- British tycoon Richard Branson takes off from Marrakesh on attempt to be first to fly round the world by balloon.
- Report says that in 1995, family enterprises employed six million people working mainly in agriculture sector.
- Nineteen Moroccan NGOs side against corruption.
- Morocco and Mali to pave the way for new ties.
- Morocco to continue supporting the Palestinian Authority.
